title: aphanostylis flavidiflora
intro: Aphanostylis flavidiflora, commonly known as Yellow Frangipani, is a plant species within the family Lauraceae. The Yellow Frangipani is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Aphanostylis flavidiflora include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
